hotspots.name: Iran war & Persian Gulf
hotspots.summary: Iran's IRGC fired two one-way attack drones at Bahrain on 13 Nov, claiming it destroyed a US early-warning radar in retaliation for an 'enemy' air strike on a telecom tower in Sirik on the Hormuz coast; CENTCOM said US forces shot both down with no injuries or damage. Reuters calls it the first claimed Iranian attack on US military assets in a Gulf country since early September. It follows Trump's 12 Nov post that the US no longer needs a deal with Iran and his removal of Vance from the file. Iran's IRGC navy says an LNG carrier hit a mine and exploded in the eastern strait, after two oil tankers caught fire on 12 Nov, and UKMTO rates the threat in the strait as severe. Iran's Assembly of Experts has called for a review of the defense doctrine and said leaving the NPT is an 'unavoidable necessity'. Israel's security cabinet has ordered readiness for a possible strike; CENTCOM calls reports that it urged Israel to prepare 'pure speculation'. Rubio says economic pressure makes large-scale operations unnecessary, while Trump says he would not hesitate to renew strikes; Turkey and Qatar signed a mutual defence pact. The IAEA says it cannot confirm Iran has not diverted declared nuclear material. Brent settled near $96.

On 10 Nov unidentified attackers fired about a dozen rounds at a UNIFIL patrol near Wadi Jilu in Tyre district; the peacekeepers returned fire and no one was hurt. Lebanon's Health Ministry says Israeli attacks since 2 March have killed 4,390 people. Israel has asked Lebanon, via US mediators, to keep Hezbollah out of any renewed Iran war, and Trump says annual US aid to Israel, about $4bn, will end after 2026. In Gaza, Israeli tank fire killed three people in eastern Deir al-Balah on 13 Nov and a baby died of hypothermia in the first cold death of the winter, as more than 50 countries urged Israel to let in winter supplies.

In North Kordofan the army says it retook Kazgeil and Abu Qaoud, about 45 km south of El-Obeid, on 5 Nov, and in West Kordofan it says it took Ayal Bakhit and Umm Marahik in Al-Khuwei district and downed its fourth drone in a week. Khartoum says 28 RSF drone attacks were launched from Ethiopian territory in October; on 4 Nov Ethiopia closed Sudan's consulate in Asosa and Sudan ordered Ethiopia's consulate in Gedaref shut. In Blue Nile state, a local governor said an RSF drone strike killed nine civilians in Bani Shako village in Kurmuk locality, reported on 10 Nov, amid fighting with the RSF and its SPLM-N ally near the Ethiopian border. On 13 Nov the army said it seized several areas around RSF-held Al-Khuway and shot down another strategic drone that crossed from Ethiopia into Blue Nile.

hotspots.name: Russia–Ukraine war
hotspots.summary: After more than two hours of Kremlin talks with Putin on 12 Nov, US envoys Witkoff and Kushner briefed Zelensky at Casement Aerodrome near Dublin; Kushner said the deal cannot be concluded without Europeans at the table and that Putin will 'give it a try'. Putin rejects demilitarized zones, saying the only demarcation line is the state border, and warns foreign peacekeepers would be targets. Zelensky says the largest prisoner exchange of the war is being prepared. Fighting goes on: Ukrainian drones set the Lukoil refinery in Volgograd ablaze overnight into 13 Nov, killing four workers, while 467 drones flew toward the Moscow region and its airports closed for hours. Russia launched 117 drones at Ukraine, setting a Kyiv hospital on fire, and attacks killed 9 people across Ukraine in a day; later on 13 Nov strikes killed a rescuer in Zaporizhzhia and two people in Odesa. Britain has sanctioned all ten of Russia's largest oil producers, and EU ministers are due to list refiners, shadow-fleet firms and 50 banks on 16 Nov.

news.headline: Ukrainian drones set Russia's Kirishi refinery ablaze; Russia hits substations and a ship
news.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack set fire to Russia's second-largest refinery at Kirishi, killing one woman, while Moscow said it struck three Ukrainian power substations and a cargo ship in the Black Sea.

news.headline: Houthis say toll from airstrike near Sanaa rises to 44
news.summary: Houthi health authorities said strikes on homes in al-Shariya, east of Sanaa, on 7 Nov killed at least 44, including 21 children, and wounded 40; they blame Saudi Arabia and searches continue.

news.headline: Russia, Ukraine and US set for first trilateral talks in nine months in Abu Dhabi
news.summary: Witkoff and Kushner will host Ukraine's Rustem Umerov and Russia's Vladimir Medinsky on 10–11 Nov in Abu Dhabi; analysts expect at most technical progress on issues such as a Black Sea or energy ceasefire and prisoner swaps.

news.headline: Russian strike on Odesa food warehouse kills three as 317 drones hit Ukraine
news.summary: A strike on an Odesa warehouse storing food for kindergartens and schools killed three, after Russia launched 317 drones overnight and hit sites in Kremenchuk, Sumy, Cherkasy and Kherson.

news.headline: Trump meets Qatar's PM on Iran as Tehran says US struck Qeshm again
news.summary: Trump and Vance were due to meet Qatar's prime minister in Washington with no deal seen imminent; Iranian state media said the US struck Qeshm Island overnight and Iran said a tanker hit a mine east of Hormuz.

news.headline: Canada sanctions 62 targets in Russia's missile industry and cyber networks
news.summary: At the G7 foreign ministers' meeting in Paris, Canada sanctioned 38 entities and 24 individuals tied to Russian ballistic-missile production, cyber activity and war financing, including crypto exchanges.

news.headline: Saudi East-West oil pipeline hit in Medina region
news.summary: Saudi state media said an attack on the pipeline that carries crude around Hormuz to the Red Sea caused a limited fire that was put out, with no casualties and no effect on operations; no attacker was named.

news.headline: Israeli jets strike villages across southern Lebanon
news.summary: Israeli aircraft struck Kfar Tibnit, Mayfadun, Markaba, Tallous and Al-Qantara, drones hit Deir Mimas and Al-Jarmaq and artillery shelled five more villages, wounding residents harvesting olives, according to Lebanese local media.

news.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed three Houthi missile production sites
news.summary: The coalition said it destroyed a missile-component factory, a solid-propellant plant and an electronics workshop used by the Houthis, in response to repeated attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen.

news.headline: Trump sees 'positive momentum' toward Iran deal after Qatar talks
news.summary: After meeting Qatar's prime minister at the White House, Trump said renewed US strikes on Iran were 'quite unlikely' and the war could end 'fairly soon', but that the US stays 'locked and loaded'; Iran says it will not negotiate unless its seven conditions are met.

news.headline: Russian strike hits Trypillia power plant near Kyiv
news.summary: State energy firm Centrenergo said Russian forces struck the Trypillia Thermal Power Plant, less than 30 km south of Kyiv, on 9 Nov, warning of 'extremely serious' consequences as the full damage is assessed.

news.headline: UKMTO: Hormuz shipping 'well below normal but not stalled'
news.summary: UKMTO's weekly count to 10 Nov shows 170 outbound and 155 inbound transits, about 65% below pre-war levels, with most transponder-on ships using the northern route through Iranian waters; JMIC tracking puts daily transits at about 10 or fewer.

news.headline: Oil holds near lowest since August on Iran deal hopes
news.summary: Brent traded near $92.50 early on 10 Nov after falling almost 6% on 9 Nov, while European gas hit a four-week low near €81/MWh; traders await monthly EIA, OPEC and IEA reports.

news.headline: Drones target Russian aircraft repair plant and Crimea overnight
news.summary: Explosions were reported near the 123rd Aircraft Repair Plant in Staraya Russa, Novgorod Oblast, and Sevastopol's Russian-installed governor said eight Ukrainian drones were downed; Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 162 drones and a ballistic missile.

news.headline: Saudi coalition intercepts Houthi missiles over Riyadh
news.summary: The coalition said it intercepted a ballistic and a cruise missile fired at Riyadh, another ballistic missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia and a drone over the Eastern Province, while Houthi media reported Saudi airstrikes on a gas station and a state oil company building in Sanaa.

news.headline: Gulf states approve military command headquarters in Kuwait
news.summary: GCC defence ministers meeting in Bahrain approved a joint military command headquarters in Kuwait as Iran and Houthi attacks on Gulf states continue.

news.headline: US-mediated Russia–Ukraine talks open in Abu Dhabi
news.summary: Kushner and Witkoff opened two days of talks with Ukraine's Umerov and Russia's Medinsky, the first three-way round since February, focused on security guarantees; Putin still demands Ukraine leave four regions and opposes a general ceasefire.

news.headline: UN peacekeepers come under fire in southern Lebanon
news.summary: UNIFIL said about a dozen rounds were fired at a patrol near Wadi Jilu in Tyre district by unidentified attackers; the patrol returned fire and no one was hurt.

news.headline: Kim Yo Jong attacks UN chief over DMZ mine-blast remarks
news.summary: Kim Jong Un's sister accused Guterres of a 'prejudiced' stance after he warned of escalation risks on the inter-Korean border, and said he would bear responsibility if South Korean 'provocations' caused an incident.

news.headline: Riyadh moves schools online as daily Houthi attacks continue
news.summary: Riyadh schools switched to online classes from Tuesday with no end date, after residents received aerial-threat shelter warnings on three consecutive days.

news.headline: Russian drones kill two in Ladyzhyn as talks open
news.summary: Drones hit energy and civilian infrastructure in Ladyzhyn in Vinnytsia region, killing two; Russian attacks killed nine across Ukraine over the previous day.

news.headline: Iran denies Hormuz-for-assets deal as Rubio says no need to resume combat
news.summary: Iran denied reports it would reopen Hormuz in return for $8bn of frozen assets and said no talks are under way until its seven conditions are met, while Rubio said major US combat operations are not needed.

news.headline: Brent falls below $90 for first time since August
news.summary: Brent slid to about $89 and WTI below $85 on expectations of a diplomatic end to the Iran war, as Trump signalled more strikes may not be needed and Hormuz traffic rose; gold fell 2% on hot US inflation data.

news.headline: Canada reimposes sanctions on 11 Iranian entities
news.summary: At the G7 in Paris, Canada relisted entities including the National Iranian Oil Company, its tanker company and Banks Mellat and Melli, delisted after the 2015 nuclear deal.

news.headline: New wave of tanker attacks around Hormuz
news.summary: The IRGC said two tankers on 'unauthorised' routes were left burning after explosions and a third hit a mine, UKMTO reported a tanker struck by a projectile off Oman, and ADNOC said one of its vessels was damaged in UAE waters; it is unclear whether the incidents overlap.

news.headline: First day of Abu Dhabi talks ends after nearly four hours
news.summary: Rubio called the opening day of US-mediated Russia–Ukraine talks 'very productive' and Zelensky called it 'constructive', but no quick deal is in sight; talks continue on 11 Nov.

news.headline: Hundreds of drones fly both ways before second day of talks
news.summary: Russia said it downed 627 Ukrainian drones over 22 regions as strikes set fire to the Baltic port of Ust-Luga and killed two in Smolensk, while Russian drones and missiles hit six power substations across central Ukraine.

news.headline: Oil rebounds from 10-week low as Iran hardens stance
news.summary: Brent rose to about $93 as Iran's security chief said no enriched uranium would leave the country and denied talks were under way, while attacks on Hormuz shipping continued.

news.headline: Iran says tanker hit mine in eastern Hormuz
news.summary: Iran's army said an oil tanker caught fire after striking a mine in a 'restricted area', a day after an Indian-crewed VLCC was hit by a projectile and four crew were injured; Reuters counts 10 ship attacks so far in November.

news.headline: Yemeni forces and Houthis claim heavy losses on several fronts
news.summary: The government said it killed or wounded about 190 Houthi fighters across six provinces on 10 Nov, the Houthis claimed heavy government losses in Lahij and al-Jawf, and the coalition intercepted more missiles fired at Riyadh.

news.headline: US moves aircraft and officials over Iranian threats
news.summary: The US pulled refuelling aircraft from RAF Mildenhall after a reported Iranian threat, and Treasury Secretary Bessent reportedly moved to a military base after a threat against his life.

news.headline: Abu Dhabi talks end with large prisoner-swap deal
news.summary: Russia and Ukraine agreed a large prisoner exchange after two days of US-mediated talks but made no breakthrough on territory; Kushner and Witkoff will brief Putin in Moscow and then meet Zelensky.

news.headline: EU envoys agree to widen Russia sanctions list
news.summary: EU ambassadors agreed to add more than 100 people and entities, including banks, oil and shipping firms, some based in the UAE, Hong Kong and Oman, pending ministers' approval on 16 Nov.

news.headline: More ships hit near Hormuz as Iran claims mine strikes
news.summary: Ambrey said a projectile disabled a merchant ship's engine room about 7 nm northeast of Lima, Oman, and UKMTO reported an incident involving a tanker identified as the Saudi-flagged NCC Fajr, a day after the tanker SEA 1 was struck off the same coast.

news.headline: Russian strike on Chornomorsk market kills three
news.summary: A Russian strike hit a market in central Chornomorsk in Odesa region, killing three people and injuring 11, four of them critically, as the Abu Dhabi talks wrapped up.

news.headline: Saudi coalition downs Houthi drones aimed at Mecca region
news.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed two drones launched toward the Mecca region and the south, and later intercepted two missiles after civil-defence alerts in Taif, Yanbu and Khamis Mushait; the Houthis denied targeting Mecca.

news.headline: Israel's security cabinet orders military to prepare for possible Iran strike
news.summary: Israeli media reported that Netanyahu's security cabinet told the military to step up readiness for a possible attack on Iran, after Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming the next government, urged the caretaker PM not to act without an immediate threat.

news.headline: Kushner and Witkoff to meet Putin in Moscow, then Zelensky in Dublin
news.summary: After the Abu Dhabi talks, the US envoys are due to see Putin on 12 Nov and then brief Zelensky in Dublin; Europe's role in future talks remains the main dispute, and Ukrainian officials talk of a possible deal by the new year.

news.headline: Russia hits Kyiv and 17 sites with missiles and drones hours after talks
news.summary: Russia fired Iskander, KN-23 and Zircon missiles and 123 Shahed-type drones overnight into 12 Nov, causing power cuts in nine regions; a drone set a Kyiv apartment block ablaze, and strikes across Ukraine killed 10 people that day.

news.headline: Iran warns of retaliation reaching Europe and rejects uranium transfer
news.summary: Tehran said it would retaliate and widen the war beyond the region if attacked, rejected a US proposal to move its 60% enriched uranium to a third country, and Ghalibaf said Washington must decide on Iran's latest proposal.

news.headline: Gold slips below $4,000 as oil holds near $92
news.summary: Gold fell below $4,000 an ounce on a stronger dollar and December rate-hike bets, while Brent held near $92 and WTI near $86 with the US and Iran deadlocked but avoiding escalation.

news.headline: Reports of heated Trump–Netanyahu call over restarting Iran war
news.summary: Ynet reported that a weekend call between Trump and Netanyahu turned into a shouting match over whether to resume the war, which Netanyahu's office denied, while Iran added compensation for environmental damage to its conditions for a deal.

news.headline: UK sanctions all ten of Russia's largest oil producers
news.summary: Britain said it is the first country to target all ten of Russia's biggest oil producers, adding Slavneft, Rosneft's Vostok Oil project, coal companies and shadow-fleet tankers carrying Russian oil and LNG.

news.headline: Putin meets Witkoff and Kushner in the Kremlin
news.summary: Putin held more than two hours of talks with the US envoys in Moscow on ways to settle the war, a day after the Abu Dhabi trilateral round ended without a territorial breakthrough; no results were announced.

news.headline: Trump says US doesn't need a deal with Iran and takes Vance off the file
news.summary: Trump wrote that 'those days have long since passed' and that the US has Iran's money and its strait, and told Vance, who had led quiet outreach to Tehran, to focus on domestic corruption instead; Iran's military warned any new attack would meet a response '10 times' stronger.

news.headline: European gas jumps 9% on cold weather and Norwegian outage
news.summary: Dutch TTF gas rose about 9% to near €95/MWh as forecasts turned colder, Norway's Troll field suffered an outage and EU storage stayed below 72%, with Trump's Iran comments adding to supply worries.

news.headline: Oil climbs and gold slides below $3,900
news.summary: Brent topped $94 after Trump's post and was near $95.50 by early 13 Nov, while gold fell more than 2.5% to a multi-month low as hot US inflation pushed the dollar to a 19-month high.

news.headline: Kushner says Europe must join next Ukraine talks after meeting Zelensky
news.summary: Witkoff and Kushner briefed Zelensky at Casement Aerodrome near Dublin after their Kremlin talks; Kushner said the deal cannot be concluded without Europeans at the table, while Putin insists the only demarcation line is the state border and rejects foreign peacekeepers.

news.headline: UN Security Council renews Houthi sanctions and targets drone parts
news.summary: The Council extended asset freezes and travel bans to November 2027, condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and shipping, and asked its expert panel to list commercial components used in Houthi drones and missiles.

news.headline: Taiwan says China massed 100+ vessels in unannounced Pacific drills
news.summary: Taiwanese officials say the 'silent' drills, larger than Justice Mission 2025, simulated attacks on cities and involved three theater commands and the carrier Liaoning, with about 70 vessels still inside the first island chain, ahead of an expected Trump–Xi meeting at APEC in Shenzhen.

news.headline: Iran fires drones at US forces in Bahrain after 'enemy' strike on Sirik

news.headline: Ukrainian drones set Volgograd refinery ablaze, killing four

news.headline: Iran says LNG carrier hit a mine and exploded in Hormuz
news.summary: The IRGC navy said a tanker carrying liquefied natural gas struck a naval mine while using an 'unauthorised and dangerous route'; no details of the ship were available.

news.headline: Russian attacks kill 9 across Ukraine and set a Kyiv hospital on fire
news.summary: Russia launched 117 drones overnight; a downed drone set fire to a Kyiv hospital, injuring three and forcing 30 evacuations, and strikes killed four in Donetsk region and hit Zaporizhzhia, Odesa and Sumy.

news.headline: Houthis seize hilltops overlooking Aden as government fortifies city
news.summary: Yemeni government forces are stacking sandbags and digging tunnels west and north of Aden after Houthi fighters took strategic hills in Al-Madaribah wal Ara district, AFP reports.

news.headline: Zelensky says largest prisoner exchange of the war is being prepared
news.summary: After meeting Witkoff and Kushner in Ireland, Zelensky said Ukraine is counting on the biggest prisoner swap since the invasion and wants Europeans at the negotiating table, while Moscow questioned their role.

news.headline: Sudan army pushes around Al-Khuway and downs a drone from Ethiopia
news.summary: The army and allied forces say they seized several areas around RSF-held Al-Khuway in West Kordofan, and air defences shot down a strategic drone that crossed from Ethiopia into Blue Nile state.

news.headline: Gaza records first cold death of winter as shelling kills three
news.summary: A nine-month-old died of hypothermia in a flooded tent and Israeli tank fire in eastern Deir al-Balah killed three people, including a boy, as more than 50 countries urged Israel to let in winter supplies.

events.title: Woman killed by Israeli gunfire near Khan Yunis

events.summary: Two people were killed in separate Israeli strikes near the central Gaza town, Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital said.
events.title: Israeli strikes kill two near Al-Zawayda

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed two Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Najran; debris fell and damage is being assessed.
events.title: Houthi missiles intercepted over Najran

events.summary: Russian media reported an overnight drone attack on the Afipsky oil refinery that started a fire.
events.title: Drones hit Afipsky refinery

events.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two tankers struck mines and caught fire in and east of the strait; no maritime authority has confirmed it.
events.title: IRGC claims two tankers hit mines

events.summary: Qatar's emir and Trump discussed Doha's mediation to end the Iran war, with the emir urging dialogue to prevent escalation.
events.title: Trump calls Qatar's emir on Iran war

events.summary: A Russian morning attack on the Sarny district killed one man and damaged buildings.
events.title: Man killed in Rivne region attack

events.summary: Russian forces attacked energy facilities in the Kirovohrad region overnight and in the morning.
events.title: Energy facilities hit in Kirovohrad region

events.summary: Witnesses said heavy Israeli fire toward al-Mawasi, northwest of Rafah, reached tents sheltering displaced Palestinians.
events.title: Gunfire reaches displaced tents in al-Mawasi

events.summary: At least 20 people were killed at the Al-Hadara market in Al-Waziyah district; government forces blamed a Houthi ballistic missile and the Houthis blamed Saudi Arabia.
events.title: Missile strike on Taiz market

events.summary: Iranian media reported two missiles hitting the Suza area; Trump later confirmed 'minor' US strikes that knocked out an air-defence system.
events.title: US strikes Iranian air defences on Qeshm

events.summary: Ukraine says it struck the Proton-Elektrotex plant, which makes Iskander-M components; warehouses and three houses were damaged.
events.title: Neptune missiles hit Oryol arms plant

events.summary: A fire broke out at the Saratov oil refinery after a Ukrainian drone attack, and the governor reported damage to homes.
events.title: Drones set Saratov refinery on fire

events.summary: Missile and drone strikes injured five people, damaged homes and a kindergarten, hit the Northern Bridge and cut power, heat and water.
events.title: Ballistic missiles hit Kyiv; Northern Bridge closed

events.summary: Russian drones damaged apartment buildings and an enterprise in Pavlohrad as strikes across Dnipropetrovsk region killed one person.
events.title: Drones hit Pavlohrad

events.summary: Houthi health officials said Saudi strikes on the village of al-Shariya killed 22 and wounded 30, mostly women and children.
events.title: Air strikes near Sanaa kill 22

events.summary: At a Tehran press conference the IRGC spokesman said Iran had lifted its self-imposed 2,000 km ballistic-missile range limit.
events.title: IRGC lifts missile-range limit

events.summary: Saudi air defences destroyed a cruise missile heading for the Riyadh region, which the coalition blamed on the Houthis; no damage was reported.
events.title: Cruise missile aimed at Riyadh downed

events.summary: Israeli artillery hit the outskirts of Baraachit, Wadi Zibqin and al-Arayesh in Bint Jbeil district, alongside ground searches in Khiam, Lebanon's state news agency said.
events.title: Israeli shelling around Bint Jbeil

events.summary: Iraq's foreign minister said the US asked Baghdad to close all but two of its border crossings with Iran.
events.title: US asks Iraq to close Iran border crossings

events.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker ablaze about 8 nautical miles northwest of Khasab; the crew was evacuated and the cause was not given.
events.title: Tanker on fire off Khasab

events.summary: Iranian state TV reported explosions on Qeshm Island and in Jask, Sirik and Bandar Abbas with no cause given; Tasnim tied them to Iranian forces firing at vessels in Hormuz.
events.title: Blasts on Qeshm and Hormozgan coast

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile fired toward the Eastern Province, as civil defence alerts covered Dhahran, Dammam, Abqaiq and Al-Ahsa.
events.title: Missile aimed at Eastern Province downed

events.place: King Abdullah Financial District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
events.summary: Debris from intercepted Houthi missiles blew out windows on several floors of the Aramco Tower in the King Abdullah Financial District; no injuries were reported.
events.title: Aramco tower damaged in Riyadh

events.summary: Overnight Russian strikes on energy infrastructure left more than 600,000 people in Dnipropetrovsk region without power.
events.title: Grid strikes black out 600,000 in Dnipropetrovsk

events.summary: The Russian-held plant switched to backup diesel generators after a damaged external power line was disconnected.
events.title: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant loses off-site power

events.summary: Russian attacks over the past day killed five people in Donetsk region, two of them in Kramatorsk, regional officials said.
events.title: Russian attacks kill five in Donetsk region

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a ballistic missile launcher in Sanaa that the Houthis used to target Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province.
events.title: Coalition destroys Houthi missile launcher in Sanaa

events.summary: A Russian strike on an infrastructure facility in Kharkiv region left about 250,000 people without power; Zlatopil's mayor reported no casualties.
events.title: Strike on Kharkiv-region grid cuts power to 250,000

events.summary: Russia's defence ministry claimed strikes on container ships in Odesa and Chornomorsk ports and a dry cargo ship southwest of Odesa; Reuters could not verify.
events.title: Russia says it hit three cargo ships off Odesa

events.summary: Drone debris damaged the R-280 highway bridge over the Mius River in Neklinovsky district, closing a road that links Russia to occupied southern Ukraine.
events.title: Ukrainian drones damage Mius River bridge

events.summary: Russian drones struck an apartment block and a hotel, injuring seven, including a 16-year-old boy.
events.title: Drones hit apartment block and hotel in Kremenchuk

events.summary: An Israeli strike on a group of civilians in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis killed two people and wounded seven, medical sources said.
events.title: Israeli strike kills two in al-Mawasi

events.place: Khor Mor gas field, near Chamchamal, Iraq
events.summary: An unclaimed drone struck the gas storage facility at Khor Mor, halting production and cutting more than 70% of Kurdistan's power supply.
events.title: Drone hits Khor Mor gas field

events.place: Off Khor Fakkan, United Arab Emirates
events.summary: UKMTO said it was monitoring an incident about 18 nautical miles east of Khor Fakkan, with damage unknown.
events.title: UKMTO monitors incident off Khor Fakkan

events.summary: Iranian state media said the US struck Qeshm Island overnight; a provincial official said vital infrastructure was not affected and the US has not commented.
events.title: US strikes reported on Qeshm Island

events.summary: The carrier left Singapore for the Central Command area while the amphibious ship USS Makin Island left Japan, as Israel and the US readied for a possible Iran strike.
events.title: USS Theodore Roosevelt heads for the Middle East

events.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack set fire to Russia's second-largest refinery; falling debris killed one woman, the regional governor said.
events.title: Ukrainian drones set Kirishi refinery on fire

events.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said it struck Rostec's Morozov plant, which produces missile fuel, near St Petersburg.
events.title: Ukraine hits missile-fuel plant near St Petersburg

events.summary: A Russian drone hit a vehicle carrying energy workers, wounding three.
events.title: Drone hits energy workers in Sumy

events.summary: Russian artillery fire killed an 87-year-old woman in Kherson, the regional administration said.
events.title: Russian shelling kills woman in Kherson

events.summary: A Russian strike on a warehouse storing food for kindergartens and schools killed three people and seriously injured a fourth.
events.title: Strike on Odesa food warehouse kills three

events.summary: A suspected army drone struck the outskirts of a market at Gara al-Zawiya, west of Kabkabiya, killing at least two and injuring about six.
events.title: Drone strike near market west of Kabkabiya

events.summary: Israeli jets struck Kfar Tibnit and four other villages and drones hit Deir Mimas, wounding residents harvesting olives.
events.title: Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon villages

events.summary: An attack on the Saudi East-West crude pipeline caused a limited fire that was extinguished, with no casualties and operations unaffected.
events.title: East-West pipeline hit in Medina region

events.summary: G7 foreign ministers, including Rubio, met in Paris, where Canada announced new sanctions on Russia's missile industry.
events.title: G7 foreign ministers meet in Paris

events.place: Trypillia Thermal Power Plant, Ukrainka, Ukraine
events.summary: Centrenergo said Russian forces struck the Trypillia Thermal Power Plant south of Kyiv, warning of 'extremely serious' consequences.
events.title: Russian strike on Trypillia power plant

events.summary: Trump hosted Qatar's prime minister at the White House and afterwards cited 'positive momentum' toward a deal to end the Iran war.
events.title: Trump meets Qatar's prime minister on Iran

events.summary: Sevastopol's Russian-installed governor said air defences downed eight Ukrainian drones, with no casualties reported.
events.title: Ukrainian drones over Sevastopol

events.summary: Explosions were reported near the 123rd Aircraft Repair Plant in Staraya Russa during an overnight Ukrainian drone attack; damage was not verified.
events.title: Drones target aircraft repair plant

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a ballistic and a cruise missile fired at Riyadh, plus a missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia and a drone over the Eastern Province.
events.title: Houthi missiles intercepted over Riyadh

events.summary: Houthi-run Saba said Saudi airstrikes hit a gas station in Jadar district and a state oil company building in southern Sanaa; Saudi Arabia did not confirm.
events.title: Reported Saudi airstrikes on Sanaa

events.summary: Gulf defence ministers meeting in Bahrain approved a joint military command headquarters in Kuwait.
events.title: GCC approves Kuwait military command HQ

events.summary: US envoys Kushner and Witkoff opened two days of talks with Ukrainian and Russian delegations focused on security guarantees.
events.title: Russia–Ukraine–US talks open in Abu Dhabi

events.summary: Zelensky visited Denmark as the Abu Dhabi talks opened, rejecting territorial concessions and limits on Ukraine's military.
events.title: Zelensky visits Denmark

events.summary: Qatar's prime minister joined G7 foreign ministers in Paris to brief them on Iran mediation, where Canada also announced new Iran sanctions.
events.title: Qatar's PM joins G7 talks on Iran

events.summary: Unidentified attackers fired about a dozen rounds at a UN peacekeeping patrol near Wadi Jilu; the patrol returned fire and no one was hurt.
events.title: UNIFIL patrol fired on

events.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two tankers were halted by explosions and left burning and a third hit a mine; no maritime authority has confirmed it.
events.title: IRGC says tankers left burning in Hormuz

events.summary: Yemeni government forces and the Houthis both claimed heavy enemy losses in fighting around Al-Madaribah and Ras al-Ara in Lahij and in al-Jawf, as the government's counteroffensive continues.
events.title: Heavy fighting on Lahij and al-Jawf fronts

events.summary: The US removed refuelling aircraft from RAF Mildenhall after a reported Iranian threat, its second such withdrawal from a British base in three months.
events.title: US pulls refuelling jets from RAF Mildenhall

events.summary: Russian drones hit energy and civilian infrastructure in Ladyzhyn, killing two; the town declared three days of mourning.
events.title: Drones kill two in Ladyzhyn

events.summary: UKMTO said a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile off the Omani coast near the strait; the crew was reported safe.
events.title: Tanker hit by projectile off Oman

events.summary: Several Ukrainian drones hit the Baltic port of Ust-Luga, starting a fire and injuring three workers; the governor said 150 drones were downed over Leningrad region.
events.title: Drones set fire to Ust-Luga port

events.summary: The Smolensk governor said two people were killed in an overnight Ukrainian drone attack, part of what Russia called 627 drones over 22 regions.
events.title: Drone attack kills two in Smolensk

events.summary: Russia launched 163 drones and missiles overnight, hitting six large power substations in Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr and Cherkasy regions; five were injured in Zhytomyr.
events.title: Russian strikes hit substations; five hurt in Zhytomyr

events.summary: Iran's army said via state media that an oil tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine in a 'restricted area' of the eastern strait; there was no independent confirmation.
events.title: Iran says tanker hit mine in eastern Hormuz

events.summary: Russia and Ukraine agreed a large-scale prisoner exchange at the end of two days of US-mediated talks, but made no breakthrough on ending the war.
events.title: Abu Dhabi talks end with POW swap deal

events.summary: A Russian strike on a market in central Chornomorsk killed three people and injured 11, four critically, and started a fire.
events.title: Russian strike on Chornomorsk market

events.place: Strait of Hormuz off Lima, Oman
events.summary: Ambrey said a projectile hit a merchant vessel's engine room about 7 nm northeast of Lima, disabling it; no injuries or pollution were reported.
events.title: Merchant ship disabled off Lima, Oman

events.summary: Police sources told AFP that missiles hit coalition camps in western and central Aden.
events.title: Missiles hit coalition camps in Aden

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed two drones launched toward the Mecca region and the south, and later intercepted two missiles; the Houthis denied targeting Mecca.
events.title: Houthi drones toward Mecca region destroyed

events.place: Off Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
events.summary: A projectile hit the engine room of the Liberia-flagged tanker Dominica Prosperity about 14 nm northwest of Ras Al Khaimah; all 22 crew were evacuated as firefighting continued.
events.title: Tanker ablaze off Ras Al Khaimah

events.summary: Israeli media reported that the security cabinet told the military to step up preparations for a possible attack on Iran.
events.title: Israel orders readiness for possible Iran strike

events.summary: Ballistic missiles and drones hit Kyiv overnight, and a drone later set a nine-storey block in Solomianskyi district on fire, killing one and injuring seven.
events.title: Missile and drone attack on Kyiv

events.summary: A Russian drone hit a customs terminal in Kovel, setting trucks and a fuel tanker on fire and injuring one person.
events.title: Drone hits customs terminal in Kovel

events.summary: A Russian drone strike in Kherson early on 12 Nov fatally wounded a woman.
events.title: Drone strike kills woman in Kherson

events.summary: Putin held more than two hours of talks with Witkoff and Kushner on settling the war in Ukraine.
events.title: Putin meets US envoys in Kremlin

events.summary: Iranian state media said the Hormuz-coast town was hit by an unattributed air strike on a telecom tower; no casualties were reported.
events.title: 'Enemy' strike on Sirik

events.summary: Witkoff and Kushner met Zelensky at Casement Aerodrome after their Kremlin talks; Kushner said Europeans must join the next round.
events.title: US envoys brief Zelensky near Dublin

events.summary: The Security Council extended Yemen sanctions to November 2027 and moved to curb Houthi access to drone and missile components.
events.title: UN renews Houthi sanctions

events.summary: Moscow's mayor said 467 drones flew toward the capital region overnight, and Sheremetyevo, Domodedovo, Vnukovo and Zhukovsky airports imposed restrictions.
events.title: Mass drone raid on Moscow region

events.summary: A Russian overnight attack on Rivne wounded six people, including two children, and 42 residents were evacuated.
events.title: Overnight strike wounds six in Rivne

events.summary: A downed drone set fire to a hospital in Shevchenkivskyi district, injuring three and forcing 30 people to evacuate.
events.title: Russian drone sets Kyiv hospital on fire

events.summary: Taiwan says about 70 Chinese navy and coast guard vessels, with the carrier Liaoning, remain inside the first island chain after unannounced drills that peaked at more than 100 ships.
events.title: Chinese fleet massed east of Taiwan

events.summary: The IRGC said it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain; CENTCOM said US forces downed both one-way attack drones with no injuries or damage.
events.title: Iranian drones shot down over Bahrain

events.summary: Four plant workers were killed and fires broke out at the Lukoil refinery in Volgograd's southern industrial zone.
events.title: Volgograd refinery ablaze after drone attack

events.summary: The IRGC navy said a tanker carrying LNG struck a mine and exploded on an 'unauthorised' route; the ship was not named.
events.title: Iran says LNG carrier hit mine in Hormuz

events.summary: Houthi fighters seized strategic hilltops in Al-Madaribah wal Ara district as government forces fortify Aden's western and northern approaches.
events.title: Houthis take hills overlooking Aden

events.summary: A Russian strike seriously damaged a five-storey building, injuring children, and a rescuer was killed when a concrete slab collapsed during clearance.
events.title: Apartment block hit in Zaporizhzhia

events.summary: A Russian strike hit a private house in Odesa, killing two people and injuring five, two seriously.
events.title: Strike on Odesa house kills two

events.summary: Israeli tank shelling in eastern Deir al-Balah killed three people, including a 12-year-old boy, and wounded 20; Israel said it fired at suspects near the Yellow Line.
events.title: Tank fire kills three in Deir al-Balah

events.summary: Erdogan and Qatar's emir signed a mutual defence agreement in Istanbul.
events.title: Turkey–Qatar defence pact signed
